title: 1 Enoch in Ge'ez — Charles (1906) + Dillmann (1851): SCANS SECURED
edition: R.H. Charles, The Ethiopic Version of the Book of Enoch (Anecdota Oxoniensia, 1906) — the critical Ge'ez text from 23 MSS; A. Dillmann, Liber Henoch aethiopice (1851) — the editio princeps lineage. The book survives complete ONLY in Ge'ez: the Ethiopic tradition is the witness, not a version.
